arm-carbon.alt: Render of the full arm in carbon fiber, shoulder to fingertips

arm-aluminum.alt: Render of the full arm in polished aluminum

hand-model.alt: 3D model of the hand, palm, wrist and forearm frame

fea-push.alt: FEA of the wrist with the hand bent 90 degrees and 1000 N spread over the palm: von Mises stress peaks at 134 MPa

fea-inline.alt: FEA of the wrist with the hand in line and 1000 N at the palm: von Mises stress peaks at 149 MPa

midterm-hand.alt: Midterm renders of the hand: five jointed fingers on a four-part palm, front and back

forearm-midterm.alt: Midterm forearm frame in Fusion 360: an open cage of six twisted struts

forearm-final.alt: Final hand and forearm in carbon fiber: the forearm frame is now a dense lofted lattice
